description.description: A split-view security camera recording from a classroom or coaching center in 2025. Over four frames, a male instructor in a blue t-shirt and jeans confronts a male student seated on the floor at the bottom right. The instructor stands over the student and appears to strike him aggressively. The surrounding students, seated at desks with open books and notebooks, watch the altercation with looks of shock and concern. The room is narrow with white walls, stone-textured accents, and some framed posters including one that says 'GOOD VIBES ONLY'.
